voxvelo_bikes.config.title: VoxVelo Bike Settings
voxvelo_bikes.menu.button.tip: Open the VoxVelo bike settings. The Open Bike Settings key does the same while you play.
voxvelo_bikes.config.keyboard.tip: How the keyboard stands in for pedalling and steering.
voxvelo_bikes.config.rider.tip: Your weight and your own speed limit.
voxvelo_bikes.config.virtual_power.tip: The watts the pedal key stands for. More watts accelerate faster and climb better.
voxvelo_bikes.config.steering_sensitivit: How far the steering keys turn the handlebar. Lower is gentler, which helps at speed.
voxvelo_bikes.rider.mass.tip: Your weight in kg. Heavier riders accelerate slower and roll downhill faster. The server keeps it in a sane range.
voxvelo_bikes.rider.limit.tip: Your own top speed in km/h, off by default. Handy to keep an even pace with other riders. The server applies it.
voxvelo_bikes.keyboard.title: Keyboard
voxvelo_bikes.rider.title: Rider
voxvelo_bikes.rider.note: Mass and speed limit are sent to the server, which clamps them.
voxvelo_bikes.config.tire_damage.tip: Whether tires wear out while riding. Survival Only spares creative riders. Applies to all your singleplayer worlds; a server sets it in voxvelo-bikes-server.json.
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.bike_helmet: Halves crash damage on a bike. Dyeable.
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.replace_tire: Keep the wheel! Craft with a Tire to repair.
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.bike_use: Use to place; sneak + empty hand to pick up.
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.wrench_use: Left-click a bike to repair; right-click to dismantle.
message.voxvelo_bikes.missing_parts: Cannot ride: install both wheels, handlebars, and a saddle.
message.voxvelo_bikes.no_pedals: No pedals installed: this bike can only coast.
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.tire.road: Fast on roads, slips on loose ground
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.tire.mountain: Grips loose ground, drags on roads
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.bars_drop: Aero: less drag, less steering lock
tooltip.voxvelo_bikes.bars_flat: Upright: more steering lock, more drag
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.busy: A track is already being generated on this server. Use /voxvelo_bikes track status or /voxvelo_bikes track cancel.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.bad_materia: Choose a stable, full solid road block without fluids or a block entity.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.outside_bor: Track does not fit inside the world border.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.shoulder_ou: Track borders do not fit inside the world border.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.planning: Planning %s km track starting at %s, %s. Construction will finish automatically.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.cancelled: Track generation cancelled. Already placed blocks are kept; there is no undo.
commands.voxvelo_bikes.track.interrupted: Track construction interrupted: %s. Already placed blocks are kept (%s).
